title: An Adaptive Condition Monitoring Method of Wind Turbines Based on Multivariate State Estimation Technique and Continual Learning
venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement, 2023
occupied: Real wind-turbine SCADA NBM (MSET) with a new-normal data buffer, continual update of the normal model, and rules for missing/abnormal data to limit fault-detection degradation.
unconfirmed_intersection: Tiered evidence with an explicit unresolved state; delayed evidence ledger; false-absorption metrics with defined denominators; rollback lineage; cache vs parameter comparison.
role: DIRECT neighbour for normal-reference update (section 4.2 / G4d)

title: Back-propagation-based multivariate state estimation technique: A lightweight adaptive condition monitoring approach
occupied: Adaptive wind-turbine condition monitoring with dynamic model update under small/discontinuous samples.

title: Change-point detection in wind turbine SCADA data for robust condition monitoring with normal behaviour models
occupied: Context-conditioned NBM (power, speed, ambient temperature); change points from malfunction/maintenance contaminate the healthy reference; systematic clean-reference selection; annotations combine work orders, maintenance logs, peer signals and physics.
unconfirmed_intersection: Online admission under delayed evidence (vs offline cleaning), unresolved state, revocation.

title: iADCPS: Time Series Anomaly Detection for Evolving Cyber-physical Systems via Incremental Meta-learning
occupied: Continual adaptation of a TSAD model to evolving CPS distributions using limited new normal samples, with adaptive thresholds.
unconfirmed_intersection: Evidence-gated admission; false-absorption measurement; rollback lineage.

title: CLAP-S: Support Set Based Adaptation for Downstream Fiber-optic Acoustic Recognition
reviewer_reading_level: full text sections II-III (Codex); repo checked (ChatGPT)
occupied: Tip-style support-set memory on real physical sensing signals; same-shot comparison of training-free support retrieval, Tip-Adapter, Tip-Adapter-F and trainable adapters.
unconfirmed_intersection: Event classification only; no persistent normal-reference admission/revocation; no delayed evidence; no false absorption.
role: CONTRADICTS broad G4g; occupies same-shot G4c

title: Vision-language model approach for few-shot learning of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder using EEG connectivity-based featured images
occupied: Tip key-value cache and Tip-F on EEG-derived connectivity images.
unconfirmed_intersection: Not raw multivariate online anomaly detection.

title: Towards Purified Multi-Label Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models (PuRF)
occupied: Episodic cache contamination, purification and temporal refresh in cache-based TTA.
unconfirmed_intersection: Normal/fault semantic admission with external evidence; machine TSAD.
role: cache contamination cleaning is not novel

title: Monitoring Risks in Test-Time Adaptation
occupied: Monitoring post-update risk/collapse for TTA, including non-parametric prototype adaptation (T3A) and weight-update methods.
unconfirmed_intersection: Needs source calibration data and risk-proxy assumptions; not fault false-absorption.
role: general adaptation-harm monitoring is not novel

title: Online Gaussian Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models (OGA)
occupied: Streaming comparison of TDA/DMN-type cache methods with Expected Tail Accuracy over worst runs.
unconfirmed_intersection: Tail accuracy is not fault false-absorption.

title: Axle Sensor Fusion for Online Continual Wheel Fault Detection in Wayside Railway Monitoring
occupied: Changing operating conditions + semantic metadata + sparse supervision + replay continual learning for wheel-fault detection.
unconfirmed_intersection: Numerical 3D train-track simulation only; no false-promotion-of-fault-to-normal metric reported.

title: Integrating adaptive moving window and just-in-time learning paradigms for soft-sensor design (MWAdp-JITL)
occupied: Query-time selection of historical regions by similarity plus recent realised prediction error; adaptive window size; BMA weighting.
unconfirmed_intersection: Per-item persistent utility, H-step delay, contamination screening, reversible eviction (see proposal_v0.4 section 8).
role: D3 threat; G3b broad version PARTIALLY_OCCUPIED

title: Just-in-Time Correntropy Soft Sensor with Noisy Data for Industrial Silicon Content Prediction
occupied: Abnormal-sample identification, clean clusters, database augmentation and re-cleaning when new labels arrive.
unconfirmed_intersection: Anomaly-evidence protection as the evaluation target; delayed per-item utility.

title: Adaptive soft-sensor update by Latest Sample Targeting Frustratingly Easy Domain Adaptation (LST-FEDA)
occupied: Latest-sample updates of JIT soft sensors under sudden/gradual change.

title: MSDG: Multi-Scale Dynamic Graph Neural Network for Industrial Time Series Anomaly Detection
occupied: Dynamic inter-channel graphs on SMD: channel relations are useful features but vary over time.
